We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. The system likely has a sample molecule context "at hand". We need to determine carbonyl count. Could use IR spectra to see C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we don't know the molecule. Perhaps the environment already has a sample loaded. We can request carbon NMR spectra. That will show peaks; carbonyl carbons appear around 190-210 ppm. Count them.

We should use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then interpret. Let's call it.
